dates.notes: Adopted by the AU Assembly on 18 February 2024. Eight annexes, including the Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies, were adopted by the 38th Ordinary Session of the Assembly in February 2025 (Decision 911(XXXVIII), para. 12). Entry into force is governed by Article 47(2) of the Protocol, which applies Articles 23(2) and 23(4) of the AfCFTA Agreement (22 ratifications, then 30 days). The AU treaty page and the general treaties index consulted on 26 November 2026 display no entry-into-force date, no ratification table and no status list for this Protocol; no depositary notification was located. The 39th Assembly (Decision 975(XXXIX), para. 5, 14-15 February 2026) still urged Member States to ratify the Protocol by the end of 2026; its decision contains no new digital-trade annex, and the treaty page's annex links remain the February 2025 compiled set.

legal_nature.rationale: A protocol to the AfCFTA Agreement, adopted by the Assembly, with signature, ratification or accession (Article 47) and entry into force governed by Article 23(2) of the AfCFTA Agreement. Its Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies contains 'shall' obligations, including national treatment and non-discrimination.

ai_provisions: Article 2(2)(f) - a specific objective: encourage trusted, safe, ethical and responsible adoption and regulation of emerging and advanced technologies to support digital trade

Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies, Article 4 - State Parties shall facilitate, promote and foster deployment and use; shall adopt or maintain laws and regulations; shall not deny a person of another State Party digital trade solely on the basis that the person deploys or uses emerging and advanced technologies
Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies, Article 5 - national treatment: no less favourable treatment for emerging and advanced technologies developed in the territory of other State Parties

Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies, Article 12 - technical standards and regulations for safe, responsible and ethical deployment; harmonisation, interoperability, risk-based approach and stakeholder consultation
Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies, Article 1(b) - defines emerging and advanced technologies to include artificial intelligence and machine learning
relevance.excluded_scope: The Protocol is not confirmed in force. The obligations described are those of the text and bind only State Parties once the Protocol is in force and applicable to them. The Annex does not create product-safety certification, a ban on particular AI uses, or an AI-specific supervisory authority; its AI content is framed by digital-trade disciplines. Article 48(4) gives State Parties five years from entry into force to align national laws.
relevance.reason: A continental digital-trade protocol whose objectives expressly include emerging and advanced technologies (Article 2(2)(f)) and which has an Annex on Emerging and Advanced Technologies. The Annex is not merely cooperative: Article 4 requires each State Party to facilitate deployment and not to deny market access solely because a person uses emerging technologies; Article 5 imposes a national-treatment obligation; Article 12 requires technical standards and regulations for safe, responsible and ethical deployment and their harmonisation. The Protocol is binding once in force, but entry into force is not confirmed.
